svg.title: Compilation handoffs — Python classes
svg.desc: Ordered handoffs between Numba, cuda.coop, NVRTC and nvJitLink. Successful provider bundling on a cache miss and the default kernel LTO path are shown. Group planning computes Load/Store payload dtype and item count. PayloadInference reuses the carried GroupLoweringPlan, checks explicit inputs and constructor extent, and records constructor state. prepare_calls_and_storage analyzes all original calls, retains _RewriteMatch records, validates descriptor ownership, prepares providers, and collects scratch requirements from their compiled layouts. Later consumers can supply facts needed by earlier constructors. begin_rewrite stages shared backing in the entry block so it dominates every scratch view. match selects each block; apply reuses or materializes invocables and emits statements in source order. ThreadData holds each thread's payload; TempStorage describes cooperative scratch. Standalone payload-write dtype inference remains in apply. finish_rewrite cleans unused bindings after all replacement blocks are installed, preserving original definitions throughout emission. These steps belong to one planner, not separate compiler passes. Facts belong to the current IR and compilation attempt. Provider artifact caches and pipeline placement are unchanged.
